text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A in stages after large gains felt rewarding, but I should base future sales on my portfolio plan and risk—not on the pleasure of locking in a gain.","My account value rose overall despite periods of decline, and a short run of results cannot tell me what prices will do next; I should stay diversified and avoid treating recent moves as forecasts.","Before trading, I should check how a buy or sale changes my holdings and cash, and avoid reversing decisions without a clear reason."]}
